name: RELATIVE_UP_PRIORITY_V1
scope: Two event-entry arms, per-stock continuous lifecycle in each fixed birth window. NOT full strategy, NOT shared account. Original fast channel excluded in both arms. No capital-rule expansion.

arms.RELATIVE_UP_PRIORITY: Known feasible slots: fresh relative_event==1 first, PVR descending, sid ascending; UNKNOWN keeps exact original feasible slot

start_end: Each arm/window begins flat, no inherited actual account inventory. Shifted M/S computed on full warm panels, not restarted. Stop new birth admission at window end; manage held positions including profitable fresh-CP adds until existing data end 2026-06-30. No forced liquidation.
events: Use already sealed A/B identities unchanged. A=Sprev0,St1,Mt1; B=Sprev1,St1,Mprev0,Mt1. UNKNOWN/left excluded, not false. Full original M3 window and common domain unchanged.
queue: At t close process original open and held-close first. Only flat, original I/PVR qualified and checkclose PASS enter ranking. UNKNOWN relative keeps original feasible index; reorder known indices only. Two per industry/day. Never filter non-UP. Next-open failure no replacement.
clock: Process OPEN actions then CLOSE facts then new birth queues. New receipt can reenter only after previous sell_all actually executed, including same day OPEN exit then CLOSE new edge. No stored receipt replay. Next common OPEN failure never replaced by another candidate.
sizing: 1200000 CNY fixed sizing reference; initial cash<=24000 including fees, planned floor loss<=3000 including fees; close proxy quantity not a fixed order. Next-open quantity recomputed from same frozen budget/risk/capacity, may increase on lower OPEN as original simulator. 5bp adverse buy and sell slippage. Dated minimum-lot/fee rules. Capacity original last20 positive raw-volume observations through signal close,1% mean, inherited proxy not improved. Full-day execution liquidity not known.
holding: Actual simulated same-stock state per arm/window. All A/B receipts while held/pending are blocked, never convert losing position to add. Existing profitable freshCP at t and profitable net liquidation at next OPEN required for single add; original one max2% nominal add,cumulative marked slot<=4%, original3000 plan-risk algorithm. I exit and CP add-floor exit unchanged. Industry0/UNKNOWN blocks fresh adds, never forces exit. Held management continues after birth window.
unknown: Missing/invalid OPEN, source lineage change, factor change, unavailable dated rules, ambiguous entry outcome lock this stock UNKNOWN for remainder of window. Explicit known nofill (OPEN<=protection or zero affordable quantity) returns flat. Held missing/invalid CLOSE or I/CP facts locks UNKNOWN. Source/adjustment metadata only comparable-path condition, not historical open-time exchange permission. End pending/held censored, not loss/win.
fees: Original dated fee engine and adverse slippage, no fee waiver. Results only conditional completed stock-round net win, average win/loss in CNY and return units, tail>=30%, fees and not-completed. No sum interpreted as account return. Costs and original shared capital feasibility separate.
attribution: Compare A_UNION_B versus RELATIVE_UP_PRIORITY, separately by birth window, full round and independent-fee core, including same-event retention and displaced/new selections. Not A_ONLY comparison.
limitations: static future stock pool/industry membership NON-PIT
historical limit-up/down, suspension, open queue/orderability unknown
current prepared daily source facts may carry revision risk
common calendar and M3 mu warm-history inherited
earlier prices/research already seen, not out-of-sample
not complete quick-entry strategy or shared account; no strategy win-rate claim
audit_notes: Original execution functions AST checked unchanged except run_window queue call.
This experiment writes only relative_priority_v1 outputs.
Prior original-event audit is historical evidence, not a new independent audit claim.
experiment: Single frozen consumer, no parameter search, no new data, original management unchanged.
evaluation: Full rounds and independent-fee core layer; per-window UNKNOWN/CENSORED/NOFILL denominators. Right tails >=20%, >=50%, and retention of baseline positive top10/top10% ranked by return and net amount separately. Independent stock PnL sum is NOT account return.
execution_gate: Only baseline/preflight authorized initially; economic arm requires separate parent instruction.
